brand.name: POKROV
brand.public_wording_rule: Do not use VPN as a direct public product description. Keep it only for legacy names, handles, compatibility labels, and unavoidable technical identifiers.

visual_direction.name: white-mint premium utility
materials: white and mint cards with thin borders
real product mockups and simple 3D trust assets

theme_contract.mode_rule: System follows the host OS/browser preference; Light and Dark are explicit user-selectable modes.
theme_contract.light_rule: White and mint utility surfaces, thin emerald borders, soft shadows, and restrained premium contrast.
theme_contract.dark_rule: Low-glare forest canvas, mint focus accents, thin translucent borders, and soft black shadows.
theme_contract.shape_rule: Use moderate radii, stable component dimensions, and no nested-card page sections.

platform_policy.apple_rule: Show Apple as preparing only; do not add dates or primary CTAs.

data_policy.backend_extensions: Allowed when useful for truthful UI, but prefer additive fields and preserve existing clients.
data_policy.empty_states: Use honest empty states when live data is unavailable. Do not invent decorative fake operational data.

asset_policy.text_rule: Keep UI text in code, not baked into raster images.
asset_policy.subtitle_policy: No legacy subtitle text on public brand assets.
